value: Animated 3D models capability notes for Yotsuba Framework.
Bring animated 3D assets into an XNA-shaped framework with a familiar content workflow.
Yotsuba Framework supports animated 3D models as part of its game content pipeline.
Load model data, skeletons and animation clips through a workflow designed to feel familiar to XNA and MonoGame developers, then use those assets in the same cross-platform game project.
Build richer 3D scenes without abandoning the framework workflow you already know.
Keep model content organized with the rest of the project and give gameplay systems access to animated characters and articulated 3D assets.
